name: Darksiders II Deathinitive Edition

setup.text: Needs the DX11 beta: in Steam, Darksiders II > Properties > Betas, enter this code, then pick the branch "closed" (not "publicbeta").

summary: Minimap icons line up with the minimap on 21:9 and 32:9; on DX9 also the full picture instead of a zoomed-in one.

switches.Fix Minimap: The player arrow and map markers sit on the minimap again, instead of drifting off to the right of it. The minimap stays where the game puts it.
switches.Ultrawide FOV: DX9 only: shows the full 16:9 height and more at the sides, instead of a zoomed-in picture with the top and bottom cut off. A fixed field of view for your screen, like the Cheat Engine FOV table, so the game's own zoom changes are replaced.

tested: 3440x1440 (Steam, default DX9 build 852291 and DX11 beta "closed" build 17701647, October 2026)

patches.description: minimap icon layer: same fit as the HUD (min of width/1280, height/720), centred
